note: Indicative statutory calendar for the April–March financial year. Due dates move by notification (extensions are common); confirm on the portal. Where a date falls on a holiday the next working day usually applies.

events.what: Deposit TDS/TCS deducted last month (30 April for March deductions)
GSTR-1 for last month (monthly filers)
IFF (optional B2B invoice upload) for QRMP taxpayers — months 1 and 2 of the quarter
EPF ECR and payment; ESI contribution for last month
GSTR-3B with tax payment (monthly filers)
PMT-06 tax payment for months 1 and 2 of the quarter (QRMP)
Professional tax remittance (monthly in most levying states; dates vary — Maharashtra 31st, Karnataka 20th)
GSTR-1 for Jan–Mar quarter (QRMP)
CMP-08 for Jan–Mar (composition)
GSTR-3B for Jan–Mar (QRMP; 24th for some states)
GSTR-4 annual return (composition)
MSME-1 half-yearly return of overdue MSME payables (Oct–Mar)
File/renew LUT for the new financial year before the first export
Opt in/out of QRMP or composition for the year (by 30 April / 31 March respectively)
TCS return (27EQ) for Jan–Mar
LLP Form 11 — annual return of partners
TDS returns 24Q/26Q for Jan–Mar
Advance tax — 1st instalment (15% of estimated tax)
Issue Form 16 to employees; Form 16A for Jan–Mar
DPT-3 — return of deposits/outstanding loans
IEC annual update window closes (April–June) — update even with no changes
GSTR-1 for Apr–Jun (QRMP)
FLA return to RBI if you have foreign investment or ODI
CMP-08 for Apr–Jun (composition)
GSTR-3B for Apr–Jun (QRMP)
Income-tax return — individuals, proprietors, partnerships and LLPs not under audit
TDS returns 24Q/26Q for Apr–Jun
Advance tax — 2nd instalment (45% cumulative)
Annual General Meeting (companies; OPCs exempt) — first AGM within 9 months of the first FY end
DIR-3 KYC for every DIN holder
Tax audit report (Form 26 under the 2026 Rules; old 3CA/3CB-3CD)
GSTR-1 for Jul–Sep (QRMP)
ADT-1 — auditor appointment (within 15 days of the AGM)
CMP-08 for Jul–Sep (composition)
GSTR-3B for Jul–Sep (QRMP)
AOC-4 — financial statements (within 30 days of the AGM)
LLP Form 8 — statement of accounts and solvency
Income-tax return — companies and audit cases (30 Nov with transfer pricing)
MSME-1 half-yearly return (Apr–Sep)
TDS returns 24Q/26Q for Jul–Sep
MGT-7 / MGT-7A — annual return (within 60 days of the AGM)
Advance tax — 3rd instalment (75% cumulative)
GSTR-9 annual return (turnover > ₹2 crore) and GSTR-9C (> ₹5 crore) for the previous FY
Annual Performance Report (APR) for overseas investments (ODI)
Belated/revised income-tax return (Budget 2026 extends the window to 31 March on payment of a fee — verify)
GSTR-1 for Oct–Dec (QRMP)
CMP-08 for Oct–Dec (composition)
GSTR-3B for Oct–Dec (QRMP)
TDS returns 24Q/26Q for Oct–Dec
POSH annual report to the District Officer (calendar year)
Advance tax — 4th instalment (100%); presumptive taxpayers pay the whole year’s tax
Opt into composition for the next year (CMP-02); renew Shops & Establishment, trade licence and FSSAI where the year-end falls here
